    The characteristic-two decomposition of HH²(A₀)_{>0} (Proposition 7.6) #

    weights-and-parameters.tex: "Proposition 6.1 and the distinct characters χ_i now give the asserted decomposition and the one-dimensionality of every nonzero summand, with I₀ the set of i for which HH²(A₀)_{χ_i} ≠ 0."

    Here: S is a set of rows spanning the derivative cokernels, with distinct relative weights relW R = w(p_R) − ν_{v_R}. A cocycle of positive degree and character χ is a coboundary unless χ = relW R for a row R ∈ S; and if a cocycle μ_i of character relW R has nonzero class, every cocycle of that character is a multiple of μ_i up to a coboundary, in the same internal degree (char_part). With the character decomposition this gives the spanning hypothesis of Theorem 7.7 (span_A0).

      Proposition 7.6, the decomposition, in the form of the spanning hypothesis of Theorem 7.7: chosen cocycles μ_i of the characters of the spanning rows, with nonzero classes, span the positive-degree Hochschild cohomology of A₀ when every other spanning row has zero cohomology in its character.
